page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.7xlarge is a general-purpose instance type within Alibaba Cloud's compute infrastructure. Operating under a KVM hypervisor, the instance is powered by the x86_64 processor architecture and provides 32 dedicated vCPUs alongside 128 GB of system memory. This sizing aligns with a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory distribution, allocating 4.0 GB of RAM per compute core to ensure uniform multi-threaded execution without memory starvation during concurrent execution.

The hardware configuration features zero local disk storage and no discrete GPU accelerators. Because the instance relies wholly on external, network-attached block storage for system and application data, architects must factor storage volume performance and connectivity into operational designs. Dedicated CPU core allocation prevents thread contention from neighboring virtual machines, ensuring steady baseline compute execution for workloads that do not require specialized hardware extensions or onboard NVMe tiers.

This hardware balance makes the instance cost-efficient for scale-out enterprise software that needs sustained CPU throughput and reliable memory capacity without the premium associated with GPU acceleration or specialized high-IOPS local drives. Alibaba Cloud ecs.n2.7xlarge is suitable for multi-tier web application hosting, mid-sized transactional databases, batch processing pipelines, enterprise resource planning services, and distributed microservices architectures.
